title: How Singapore’s F1 Grand Prix Became The ‘Coachella of Asia’
summary: "No other festival in Asia possesses comparable buying power or influence" as the Singapore GP, WME's Brett Murrihy says.
body: SINGAPORE — With its combination of speed, glamor, artistry and science, Formula 1 is a spectacle that travels at a speed and sound nothing else can match. It was Red Bull’s Max Verstappen who bagged the 2026 Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix earlier this month with a pole-to-checkered flag win, an historic deed for the flying Dutchman who finally conquered a race that had eluded him for a decade . If Verstappen was the king of the track, The Killers, Janet Jackson, Split Enz, JJ Lin and Lana Del Rey were the stars of the live show, a music festival that pumps away when the racing pauses. With its flashy street circuit and three-day live music festival, the Singapore GP has a speed and sound quite unlike any other race on the calendar. Established in 2008, senior music industry executives are now calling it the premier annual music festival in Asia. Billboard was there to catch the action Oct. 9-11, both on track and across the event’s 11 live entertainment stages. body: فليك أشاد كثيرًا بحمزة عبد الكريم يحظى حمزة عبد الكريم بإعجاب مسؤولي برشلونة، بفضل سلوكه الاحترافي وتواضعه، واستعداده لتقبل دوره مع الفريق الأول، أو تعزيز صفوف الفريق الرديف عندما تستدعي الحاجة، في موقف يعكس نضجه رغم بلوغه 18 عامًا فقط، بحسب صحيفة "سبورت" الكتالونية. وأضافت الصحيفة: "ليس من السهل على لاعب في هذا العمر التعامل مع وضع مماثل، خاصة أن المهاجم المصري اكتسب شهرة واسعة في بلاده، بعد مشاركته في كأس العالم. ومع ذلك، أظهر حمزة قدرًا كبيرًا من التواضع والوعي، سواء في تقبّل مشاركاته المحدودة مع الفريق الأول، أو في استعداده للعب مع برشلونة أتلتيك تحت قيادة جوليانو بيليتي، عندما يُطلب منه ذلك". اقرأ أيضًا بورنموث يتحدى: لن نبيع مهاجمنا حتى لو عرض برشلونة 100 مليون يورو برشلونة يرفض الدخول في مزايدة مالية مع ريال مدريد وباريس وكان حمزة عبد الكريم حاضرًا في تدريبات برشلونة، الأربعاء، مع عودة الفريق إلى العمل عقب الهزيمتين المؤلمتين أمام باريس سان جيرمان وريال مدريد، بعدما تابع المباراتين من مقاعد البدلاء دون المشاركة. وتعود آخر مشاركة للمهاجم المصري إلى 17 أكتوبر الماضي، عندما خاض مباراته الوحيدة حتى الآن مع برشلونة أتلتيك أمام أوتيبو، وسجل هدف التقدم لفريقه من ركلة جزاء، في المباراة التي انتهت بفوز البارسا بنتيجة 2-1 على ملعب يوهان كرويف. وخلال حديثه عقب تجديد عقده حتى عام 2030،…

title: Price hikes can’t stop YouTube Premium from hitting new subscriber records
summary: Between YouTube Music and YouTube Premium, Google counts over 150 million subscribers.
body: TL;DR Alphabet published its Q3 2026 financial report this afternoon. In sharing the news, CEO Sundar Pichai announced that YouTube Music and Premium now have over 150M subscribers. That figure includes trial subscriptions, but it’s also up from the 125M the company shared earlier this year. Google — sorry, Alphabet — is sharing its latest financial report today, detailing the company’s Q3 2026 performance. And as you should only expect, that’s full of tons of data points about AI, token usage, and all things Search. But it also offer us an all-too-rare peek into how things are doing for one of the biggest streaming services around, as Google shares new YouTube subscriber figures. As CEO Sundar Pichai explains , YouTube Music and YouTube Premium now count over 150 million subscribers around the world. This past spring, that figure was only at 125 million .

title: Inside the City of Hope Gala: Stevie Nicks, Jackson Browne & More Honor Primary Wave’s Larry Mestel
summary: Nicks concluded the Spirit of Life gala with an acoustic rendition of "Landslide" and remarks about why "City of Hope has meant so much to me."
body: On Tuesday (Oct. 27), City of Hope hosted its annual Spirit of Life gala at the Pacific Design Center in Los Angeles. This year, the organization honored Primary Wave founder/CEO Larry Mestel , who spoke passionately about his support of the organization, even calling Dr. Leo Wang, one of the doctors working with City of Hope, as “the real rock star tonight,” before adding, in a self-deprecating tone: “He cures cancer in children, and I buy music catalogs,” which got a laugh from the crowd. It also featured performances by Melissa Etheridge — a breast cancer survivor herself — along with Jackson Browne and Stevie Nicks , all of whom have professional ties to Mestel and Primary Wave. There was also a virtual performance by Pete Townshend from his home, as he could not attend that night due to a medical reason. title: "هذا أجمل خبر بالنسبة لنا".. بايرن ميونخ يعلن تطورات حالة كومباني
summary: ماكس إيبرل يرفض تحديد موعد عودة المدرب

title: Android’s upcoming automatic backup tool might not play nicely with your PC

title: Oura confirms Ring 4 sync bug, but the fix is simple
summary: Oura offers workaround for confirmed Ring 4 syncing bug.
body: Credit: Kaitlyn Cimino / Android Authority TL;DR Oura has confirmed that an issue with firmware version 2.13.1 is affecting the Ring 4. The bug is preventing the Ring 4 from syncing to the Oura app. Putting your smart ring on its charger, opening the app, and waiting for the ring to connect solves the problem. Oura recently rolled out a couple of new health-related features to the Ring 3 and later — Cardio Effort and automatic VO2 Max. It also recently rolled out firmware version 2.13.1 for the Ring 4. If you haven’t updated to this firmware version yet, you may want to hold off, as it comes with an annoying bug. For those who already updated, you can rest easy, as there’s a simple way to get around the problem. Oura has confirmed on its known-issues page (via Gadgets and Wearables ) that firmware 2.13.1 is causing some issues with the Ring 4. The company warns that the update can cause the Ring 4 to stop syncing with the Oura app. This bug is apparently triggered “if you switched to a new phone after setting up your ring without completing a factory reset.”

title: Chrome can now pull autofill suggestions straight from Gmail
summary: This could be a convenience dream, but only if you're comfortable with Personal Intelligence.
body: TL;DR Google is rolling out Gemini-powered enhanced autofill in Chrome, allowing it to suggest information pulled directly from Gmail. The feature can surface order numbers, package tracking details, and flight bookings when filling out online forms. It’s rolling out in the US on desktop, Android, and iOS for users with Gemini in Chrome and Personal Intelligence enabled. Google Chrome’s autofill is getting eager to help you out — a little too eager, if you ask us. Earlier this year, the tech giant started testing a feature that would let Gemini fill out forms in Chrome with information from across your Google account. Now, the company is bringing a more stable version of that functionality to a lot more users. For reference, when we reported on the development earlier this year, the autofill update was limited to Chrome Canary. Fast-forward to today, and it’s rolling out to all Gemini Personal Intelligence users in the US.

title: Google opens the floodgates for more connected apps in Gemini and Search
summary: Google says Gemini and Search now have over 50 connected app integrations, with more on the way.
body: TL;DR Google has unveiled the Connected Apps Platform, designed to help more developers bring their apps to the Gemini and Search connected apps ecosystem. The platform will initially be available in preview to US-based developers, with Google saying it will add more developers and regions soon. Google adds that it will bring more connected apps to Gemini and Search, including mindfulness app Calm. Giving AI access to our favorite apps opens up all sorts of possibilities. Already, connected apps in Gemini and Search make it easier to access information without switching apps, like finding something from your emails via Gmail, or booking a table using OpenTable. While several apps are currently compatible with connected apps in Gemini (but not so many in Search), Google is taking early steps to let more developers into the ecosystem. In a blog post published today, Google announced the Connected Apps Platform, which will let businesses and developers bring their own apps to the already growing list of connected apps in Gemini and Search. This will be part of a limited developer preview, available only to US-based developers.

title: Researcher raises alarming privacy concerns about Samsung TVs, even those without mics

body: TL;DR A researcher claims Samsung TVs without built-in microphones may access microphones in connected soundbars and Bluetooth devices, but no independent evidence proves this. The researcher also alleges Samsung TVs collect audio events, track viewing habits, and may continue sending ACR telemetry even when the feature is disabled. Samsung has faced previous privacy scrutiny, including a Texas ACR settlement and lawsuits over data collection. Smart TVs have raised privacy concerns for years, especially over how much information they collect about what we watch. title: Android is locking down permissions to keep apps from messing with your contacts

body: TL;DR Android apps that get permission to change your contacts can currently access all of them. Google’s interested in limiting that with a system that distinguishes between individual and bulk edits. The first components are arriving with Android 17 QPR2 later this year. Keeping Android users safe is one of the most challenging problems Google faces with its mobile operating system, and one of the many ways it’s managed to address the task is through the development of Android’s permission system . By only granting apps a narrow set of permissions that they truly need, we can limit the ability of secretly malicious or otherwise compromised apps to do harm. Today we’re leaning about an update to how permissions work when it comes to contacts, and why Google’s making the change. Over on X, Google’s Mishaal Rahman is highlighting some upcoming changes for how apps are allowed to manage our contacts on Android, further detailed in a developer blog post . Right now, the problem is that contacts permissions aren’t granular enough — an app that just wants to add or update one contact gets the same WRITE_CONTACTS permission that an app that wanted to change all of your contacts would.
